title: Lease vs Buy a Truck in 2027: The $10,000 Tax Twist Most Buyers Miss
description:
The average new car payment in America just hit a record seven hundred eighty-seven dollars a month. One in four new loans now lasts seven years or longer. More than one in five buyers is paying over one thousand dollars a month. And a new tax break in twenty twenty-six can save truck buyers real money, but only if they buy, not lease, and only if the truck was assembled in the right place.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
